stages.title: The invitation
stages.summary: Accepting and asking what to bring

sentences.en: Shall I bring wine or dessert?
Should I take my shoes off?
Can you pass me the salt?

sentences.pt: Já não consigo comer mais nada.

sentences.en: Can you give me the recipe?
It's getting late; we should go.
sentences.pt: Está a ficar tarde, temos de ir.

sentences.en: Thank you for a fantastic evening.
Next time it's at our place.
sentences.es: La próxima vez, en nuestra casa.
sentences.pt: Para a próxima é lá em casa.

passages.text: El sábado hacemos una comida en casa con unos amigos. Venid sobre las dos. No traigáis nada, de verdad; bueno, si queréis, una botella de vino.
passages.en: On Saturday we're having lunch at home with some friends. Come around two. Don't bring anything, really; well, if you want, a bottle of wine.
passages.question: What can you bring?
passages.answer: A bottle of wine, if you want.
wrong: Nothing at all; it's not allowed.

passages.text: No sábado vamos fazer um almoço lá em casa com uns amigos. Venham por volta das duas. Não tragam nada, a sério; bem, se quiserem, uma garrafa de vinho.
passages.en: On Saturday we're having lunch at home with some friends. Come around two. Don't bring anything, really; well, if you want, a bottle of wine.
passages.question: What can you bring?
passages.answer: A bottle of wine, if you want.
wrong: Nothing at all; it's not allowed.

passages.text: ¡Pasad, pasad! No hace falta que os quitéis los zapatos. Dejad los abrigos en la habitación del fondo. La comida estará en diez minutos; mientras tanto, ¿qué queréis beber?
passages.en: Come in, come in! No need to take your shoes off. Leave your coats in the room at the back. Food will be ready in ten minutes; meanwhile, what would you like to drink?
passages.question: What does the host say about shoes?
passages.answer: You don't need to take them off.
wrong: Leave them in the back room.

passages.text: Entrem, entrem! Não é preciso tirarem os sapatos. Deixem os casacos no quarto do fundo. A comida fica pronta daqui a dez minutos; entretanto, o que querem beber?
passages.en: Come in, come in! No need to take your shoes off. Leave your coats in the room at the back. Food will be ready in ten minutes; meanwhile, what would you like to drink?
passages.question: What does the host say about shoes?
passages.answer: You don't need to take them off.
wrong: Leave them in the back room.

passages.text: La receta es de mi abuela: el secreto es dejar el arroz quieto, sin removerlo, los últimos diez minutos. Si queréis, os la mando por mensaje. ¿Alguien quiere repetir?
passages.en: The recipe is my grandmother's: the secret is to leave the rice alone, without stirring, for the last ten minutes. If you want, I'll send it to you by message. Does anyone want seconds?
passages.question: What's the secret of the recipe?
passages.answer: Don't stir the rice in the last ten minutes.
wrong: Cook it for only ten minutes.

passages.text: A receita é da minha avó: o segredo é deixar o arroz quieto, sem mexer, nos últimos dez minutos. Se quiserem, mando-vos por mensagem. Alguém quer repetir?
passages.en: The recipe is my grandmother's: the secret is to leave the rice alone, without stirring, for the last ten minutes. If you want, I'll send it to you by message. Does anyone want seconds?
passages.question: What's the secret of the recipe?
passages.answer: Don't stir the rice in the last ten minutes.
wrong: Cook it for only ten minutes.

passages.text: ¿Ya os vais? Bueno, el último metro es a la una. Si lo perdéis, en la esquina suele haber taxis. Mandadme un mensaje cuando lleguéis.
passages.en: Leaving already? Well, the last metro is at one. If you miss it, there are usually taxis on the corner. Send me a message when you get home.
passages.question: What does the host ask you to do?
passages.answer: Send a message when you get home.
wrong: Call a taxi from the flat.

passages.text: Já vão? Bem, o último metro é à uma. Se o perderem, na esquina costuma haver táxis. Mandem-me uma mensagem quando chegarem.
passages.en: Leaving already? Well, the last metro is at one. If you miss it, there are usually taxis on the corner. Send me a message when you get home.
passages.question: What does the host ask you to do?
passages.answer: Send a message when you get home.
wrong: Call a taxi from the flat.
